cards.card_text: They call her an outcast no one cares for Her old allies finally asked Him to She healed her own wounds first
cards.verse_text: But I will restore your health and heal your wounds, declares the LORD, because they call you an outcast, Zion, for whom no one cares.”
cards.snippet: …and heal your wounds, declares the LORD, because they call you an outcast, Zion, for whom no one cares.”

cards.verse_text: “On that day,” declares the LORD, “I will gather the lame; I will assemble the outcast, even those whom I have afflicted.
cards.snippet: …declares the LORD, “I will gather the lame; I will assemble the outcast, even those whom I have afflicted.

cards.card_text: He'll make the lame into a remnant and the outcast into a ___ nation.
cards.verse_text: And I will make the lame into a remnant, the outcast into a strong nation.
cards.snippet: And I will make the lame into a remnant, the outcast into a strong nation.
